title: Consistency of the linear system solver
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set equipped with an encoding, and let $R$ be a finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in variables indexed by $\nu$. If some assignment satisfies every equation in $R$, then the assignment produced by the specified solver also satisfies every equation in $R$.
hypotheses_covered: The system has a satisfying assignment
